# Handoff Minimalism

The next reader inherits your artefacts and checks—not your confidence.

## Include

What changed at a high level, where it lives, which checks passed, and any blocker that remains true.

## Exclude

Long stylistic essays, redundant narration of history, or claims not backed by commands run.

## Tone

Factual, short, and test-linked statements outperform persuasive language.
